steps.text: Mix atta, baking powder and salt, then add yoghurt and knead briefly into a soft dough.
Rest 10 minutes, divide into 4 and roll about 5 mm thick.
Cook in a dry hot pan 2 to 3 minutes a side, then brush with oil.
steps.cue: Bubbles form on the top within a minute. Flip when brown spots show underneath, then cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
steps.tip: If the dough sticks, dust with a spoonful of atta. Keep it soft; a stiff dough makes dry bread.
